premises.text: Mobile teams need to communicate but email is insufficient for getting work done together
premises.evidence_span: email doesn't really cut it for us all the time

premises.text: Zula provides a structured team messaging stream as the base for collaboration
premises.evidence_span: we started off with a very standard messaging stream, a structured messaging stream

premises.text: Teams can share files in-stream with Dropbox and Google Drive integration and a shared-file view
premises.evidence_span: mini Dropbox, which is actually also integrated into Dropbox and Google Drive

premises.text: Dynamic in-post polls let teams gather answers inside the conversation
premises.evidence_span: I put out a poll as part of my post, a dynamic poll, which is part of the post

premises.text: Calendar events can be created for the whole team from the stream
premises.evidence_span: we can create a calendar event, calendar integration, boom. The whole team gets it

premises.text: Long-lived streams are searchable so prior conversation content can be found later
premises.evidence_span: you want to search the stream

premises.text: People are invited from contacts and social networks via deep links straight into the conversation
premises.evidence_span: They get a deep link, which takes them directly to this conversation

premises.text: One-tap conference calling starts a synchronous call for the stream without phone numbers
premises.evidence_span: we have one tap conference calling

value.text: Teams get work done with structured mobile communication that reduces email
value.evidence_span: reducing email and moving into a much more structured way of communicating as a team

causal_links.evidence_span: structured way of communicating as a team
business tools to really get things done together as a team
When I invite someone to this conversation, they come straight here
I need to actually have a synchronous conversation

notes: File share, poll, and calendar split as distinct in-stream jobs-to-be-done under enumeration atomicity. Call recording folded into P8 as cascade of the conference-call mechanism. Six-month dogfooding traction excluded per §4.2. Singletons D3 and D4 retained as independently revisable invite and sync-call modules.
